fact_text: Aloof Builders announced a residential project on Memar Avenue in Gulshan-e-Maymar, a road the speaker described as 350 feet wide, on a four-side corner plot with a boundary wall.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Gulshan-e-Maymar Karachi’s Property Future? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-01)

fact_text: Residential prices in Gulshan-e-Maymar were reported at more than 3 crore PKR as of June 2025, according to the speaker.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Gulshan-e-Maymar Karachi’s Property Future? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-01)

fact_text: Flats in Gulshan-e-Maymar were reported at about 1 to 1.5 crore PKR as of June 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Gulshan-e-Maymar Karachi’s Property Future? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-01)

fact_text: Single- and double-storey houses in the area were said to cost 50 lakh to 1 crore PKR around 2015, before the current price rise.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Gulshan-e-Maymar Karachi’s Property Future? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-01)

fact_text: A residential plot in Scheme 33, bought for lakhs of rupees about 30 years earlier, was said to have reached about 3 crore PKR and its high point.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Gulshan-e-Maymar Karachi’s Property Future? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-01)

fact_text: The speaker's rule: once plot prices in a residential area reach a high, flat prices there start to rise, so plots lead the price cycle and flats follow.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Gulshan-e-Maymar Karachi’s Property Future? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-01)

fact_text: The speaker advised that where raw land is still plentiful, buying land is better than buying flats, because flat prices rise only once that land is fully occupied.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Gulshan-e-Maymar Karachi’s Property Future? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-01)

fact_text: The speaker advised investing in developing areas whose prices have not yet reached their high, since areas already at their peak leave buyers with fewer options.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Gulshan-e-Maymar Karachi’s Property Future? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-01)

fact_text: Flats on Tariq Road and in downtown Karachi were said to have reached their peak prices, with buyers there having many options.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Gulshan-e-Maymar Karachi’s Property Future? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-01)

fact_text: Commercial land in downtown, Clifton and Central Karachi was said to be fully occupied, pushing development outward to areas such as Gulshan-e-Maymar.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Gulshan-e-Maymar Karachi’s Property Future? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-01)

fact_text: The speaker cited Scheme 33 and the Nipa area as past outskirts that became city centres as schemes filled in, and called Gulshan-e-Maymar the outskirt expected to follow them.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Gulshan-e-Maymar Karachi’s Property Future? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-01)

fact_text: Aloof Builders' three-room flat in the project was priced from about 95 lakh PKR, with about 850 sq ft of area and parking included in the price.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Gulshan-e-Maymar Karachi’s Property Future? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-01)

fact_text: The developer said its three-room flat is about 850 sq ft, while it said other developers offer three-bedroom units of only 600 to 700 sq ft.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Gulshan-e-Maymar Karachi’s Property Future? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-01)

fact_text: The two-bedroom drawing-lounge unit is described as about 1,100 to 1,150 sq ft, with the lounge and dining area together about 24 to 25 feet across.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Gulshan-e-Maymar Karachi’s Property Future? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-01)

fact_text: The project's club house has a meeting room for about 10 to 12 people and a ballroom with a capacity of 200-plus guests, plus separate ladies and gents gyms.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Gulshan-e-Maymar Karachi’s Property Future? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-01)

fact_text: The developer claimed buyers could earn a return of about 300% once residents move in, compared with other projects, a claim the speaker presented without independent data.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Gulshan-e-Maymar Karachi’s Property Future? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-01)

fact_text: The project's flats are fitted with Google smart-home devices, letting residents switch lights on and off by voice or app and check each unit's electricity use.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Gulshan-e-Maymar Karachi’s Property Future? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-01)

fact_text: The speaker expected flat prices in Gulshan-e-Maymar to climb toward 3 to 5 crore PKR over a 10 to 20 year horizon, once the area's high end is reached.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Gulshan-e-Maymar Karachi’s Property Future? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-01)
